findings.findingDescription: Non-deterministic java.util.Random instantiation in business service
causalTrace: 1. Business service method invokes global system time or unseeded random generator.
2. Method behavior cannot be frozen, simulated, or deterministically tested across environments.
3. Test suites suffer from intermittent flakiness depending on execution clock.
4. Time-dependent edge cases (leap seconds, timezone shifts) remain unverified.
findings.groundTruthEvidence: EmailNotificationService.sendPartnerOTP instantiates new Random().nextInt(999999) for authentication OTP generation, violating deterministic testability and cryptographic randomness (CWE-330). Verified True Positive (TP).
findings.reviewerNotes: Detected in Phase 4A.12 post-push revalidation. Verified TP in EmailNotificationService.sendPartnerOTP.
